justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Oncology rehab is a growing field with positive evidence; OncPT certification-specific outcomes not yet published.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS OncPT certification; experience requirements plus exam; moderate to significant investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in oncology rehabilitation and cancer survivorship programs; limited outside these specialty settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Oncology rehab billed under standard PT codes; OncPT does not unlock new billing codes.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Growing demand as oncology rehab becomes established; limited current employer base but strong trajectory.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Cancer patients value specialized PT who understands treatment side effects.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Oncology rehab is largely insurance/hospital-based; cash-pay survivorship niches exist but are small.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Rare credential supports some premium, but payer mix dampens realized pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Very few PTs hold this — strong differentiation if you build a survivorship/lymphedema-adjacent niche.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Hard to scale through other clinicians without each holding the cert or extensive mentoring.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Limited direct-to-consumer awareness; referrals come through oncologists, not patient search.
justifications.business.efficiency: ABPTS board cert is expensive, exam-heavy, with substantial clinical-hour prerequisites.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: ABPTS board specialty — gold-standard credential for faculty hiring, promotion, and tenure files.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Holders are typically publishing in survivorship, exercise oncology, and lymphedema literatures.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Strengthens medical/oncology content in DPT curricula and supports residency development.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Exercise oncology has a robust and growing RCT base (ACSM roundtable, survivorship guidelines).
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Programs increasingly want oncology coverage; preferred when listed but not universally required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: High time/cost burden relative to a generalist faculty hire.
